name: Chaitrali
reason: ālī means row or female friend, not 'born in'; Marathi name of Chaitra

fix.meaning_en: Of Chaitra, the spring month (Marathi name; etymology uncertain)

name: Esha
reason: eṣā, wish; IAST and Devanagari agree

name: Himagauri
reason: hima plus gaurī, fair as snow; epithet of Parvati, well formed

name: Kadambini
reason: kādambinī is derived from kādamba/kadamba cluster, not 'kadamba: cloud-bank'; used historically, acceptable

fix.meaning_en: Line or bank of rain clouds

name: Kamalini
reason: kamalinī, lotus pond or lotus-like woman

name: Kundana
reason: kundan is Hindi-derived, not Sanskrit; meaning needs honest etymology

fix.meaning_en: Pure gold (from Hindi kundan; etymology uncertain)

name: Madhulika
reason: 'honey bee' is madhulih; madhulikā is sweet or honey-like

name: Manjusha
reason: mañjūṣā is a casket or chest, not 'jewel casket'; also a madder plant

name: Nirupa
reason: negative_meaning: nirūpā is formless or without beauty; 'beautiful' is wrong

name: Nitika
reason: nītikā weakly attested, modern coinage from nīti but understandable

fix.meaning_en: Right conduct; guidance (from nīti; modern form)

name: Nivedya
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: naivedya is a ritual food offering; name and IAST also disagree
